_comment: Where to find each package, plus background facts - not scores. package_evidence gathers live data (repository, robot apt/installed state); the agent scores it per EVALUATION_CRITERIA.md. fieldNotes are observations from running on AD-R1M; notes are general facts about the package.

rtabmap_ros.fieldNotes: Runs on AD-R1M as ToF depth + AB image as RGB (skills/ad-r1m-robot/templates/rtabmap_depth_rgb_launch.py), the best setup: Grid/RangeMax 2.0 removes false far-floor obstacles (3.0 lets a small camera tilt lift the floor above Grid/MaxGroundHeight 0.08); ~30-40 ms per update at 2 Hz, ~13% CPU; works with Nav2 navigation_launch.py using RTAB-Map's /map.
rtabmap_ros.notes: Visual, visual-inertial, ICP and RGB-D SLAM; RGB-D, stereo, depth cameras and LiDAR. CPU-only. ROS 2 Humble/Iron/Rolling. Nav2 integration (occupancy grid). Runs on ARM. Most versatile for depth/ToF cameras.

orb_slam3_ros2.notes: Monocular, stereo, RGB-D. CPU-only (OpenCV, Pangolin, Eigen). ROS 2 Humble via a community wrapper built from source with ORB_SLAM3. No occupancy grid, so limited Nav2. Heavy for the RPi 5 (feature tracking every frame). ORB features on the 512x512 ToF AB image are untested on AD-R1M.

slam_toolbox.fieldNotes: The robot's built-in slam compose profile uses it on the /scan synthesized from the ToF depth image.
slam_toolbox.notes: 2D LiDAR SLAM, CPU-only, the default Nav2 SLAM. Not suitable for depth cameras alone.

plain_slam_ros2.notes: LiDAR + IMU, CPU-only, ROS 2. Requires a LiDAR; not compatible with depth-only robots. No known repository.

mola_lidar_odometry.fieldNotes: Runs on AD-R1M with the ToF /cam1/point_cloud as its 3D 'LiDAR' input and /imu (skills/ad-r1m-robot/templates/mola_icp_launch.py): /lidar_odometry/pose at 9.9 Hz, pose_quality 1.0, map->odom TF, mola-cli ~1 CPU core; octomap_server adds a 2D /map. Sensor topics are subscribed by the separate mola_bridge_ros2 module, so messageTypesInCode is empty for this repo. Narrow ~70 deg FOV: expect drift and roll/pitch error in open spaces.
mola_lidar_odometry.notes: LiDAR (2D/3D) odometry, optional IMU (LO and LIO modes), front-end for MOLA SLAM. CPU-only. ROS 2 Humble/Jazzy/Rolling. Moderate-heavy compute. GPL-3.0.

gs_icp_slam.notes: Gaussian-splatting ICP SLAM for point clouds. Requires a high-end GPU; limited ROS 2 support. Impractical on embedded hardware.

kiss_icp.notes: ICP odometry on any point cloud. CPU-only, lightweight, ROS 2. No loop closure, so it drifts over time.

dm_vio.notes: Monocular camera + IMU visual-inertial odometry, CPU-only. ROS 1 only: not compatible with ROS 2.
